description: This file defines the TodoProvider class, a state management class for handling Todo items in a Flutter application. It provides methods to fetch, add, toggle completion, edit, and remove todos, interfacing with an API client.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of Todo items, handles asynchronous API interactions, and provides state updates to the UI.

methods.name: fetchTodos
methods.description: Fetches the list of Todo items from the API and updates the internal list, while managing loading and error states.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Creates a new Todo via the API and prepends it to the internal list; manages loading and errors.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Optimistically toggles the completion status of a Todo, updates server, and handles rollback in case of failure.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Optimistically updates a Todo's details, syncs with server, and reverts on failure.

methods.name: removeTodo
methods.description: Removes a Todo from the list and deletes it via the API, reverting if delete fails.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Updates the loading state and notifies listeners.
